flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts (title 'Complaint Code' only), utils/models/{Icomplaintchargedesc,Icustomcomplaintchargedesc}.d.ts and Fapi.d.ts:209 (types only), pages/System/{form/RuleCodeForm,list/RuleCodeList}.tsx (complaintCode field), utils/validation/System/ValidRuleCode.ts; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/offencerulecode/{OffenceRuleCode,OffenceRuleCodeController}. No entity, controller or page for a Complaint Code master or Charge Description templates in any repo
note: The story asks the Officer to create/amend/delete Complaint Codes and about 40 Complaint Charge Description templates that pull data from OCMS tables (name, ID, offence rule) to be sent to State Courts. The code does not have this feature. The menu constant 'Complaint Code' (System.ts:9,111-114) has no Route in App.tsx and there is no page. The TypeScript type Icomplaintchargedesc (fields charge_desc, complaint_desc, hirer_charge_desc, legis_code) and the resource 'complaintchargedesc' (Fapi.d.ts:209) exist, but no component uses them and there is no entity or endpoint in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi (grep complaintchargedesc, charge_desc, chargesheet: 0 hits in Java code). The only thing close: complaint_code is stored as a required text column (max 8 characters) on Offence Rule Code, which can be created and patched but not deleted (the controller only has create, list, patch, exists). There is no merging of templates with notice data and no sending of charges to State Courts. The sheet status 'Demo paid' is not supported by code for the core of the story. No maintenance ticket relates directly.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the complaint_code field on Offence Rule Code exists; the Complaint Code master, Charge Description templates and data pull for State Courts are not built. Ask URA/the team where this feature is built, or mark as a gap

steps.step: Officer opens the Complaint Code page in the staff portal
steps.detail: System.ts only defines the path '/system/complaint-code' and the title 'Complaint Code' (System.ts:9,111-114). The 'system' Route block in App.tsx:375-503 has no complaint-code route and pages/System has no component for it. The menu does not lead to a real page.

steps.step: Officer creates a new Complaint Code
steps.detail: There is no Complaint Code master. What exists: a required, uppercase 'Complaint Code' field on the Offence Rule Code form (RuleCodeForm.tsx:199-205, ValidRuleCode.ts:72), saved through POST /v1/offencerulecode (OffenceRuleCodeController.java:53) as the complaint_code column. The code is only text per rule, with no description or type.

steps.step: Officer amends or deletes a Complaint Code
steps.detail: Amending is possible through POST /v1/offencerulecodepatch (OffenceRuleCodeController.java:103); the complaint_code value is only a text attribute of at most 8 characters (OffenceRuleCode.java:42-43). Deleting does not exist: the controller only has create, list, patch, exists (:53,86,103,148) and RuleCodeList.tsx has no ActionRemove. A change here also changes the rule code, not a Complaint Code master.

steps.step: Officer creates, amends, deletes Complaint Charge Description templates (about 40)
steps.detail: Only the type declaration Icomplaintchargedesc (charge_desc, complaint_desc, hirer_charge_desc, legis_code, start_date, end_date, etc.; Icomplaintchargedesc.d.ts:1-31) and the resource name 'complaintchargedesc' in Fapi.d.ts:209. No page, hook, controller, entity, repository or SQL uses it (grep complaintchargedesc, charge_desc, complaint_desc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui src: only .d.ts files).

steps.step: Templates pull offence data from OCMS tables (name, ID number, offence rule) into placeholders
steps.detail: No code replaces template placeholders with notice/defendant data. Grep for charge placeholder, chargesheet, charge_sheet, hirer_charge in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui: only the fields b_lob_chargesheet and file_name_chargesheet in the type Icourtcase.d.ts:43,47 with no user. The nearest thing is the complaint_code column on the rule (OffenceRuleCode.java:42-43).

steps.step: The correct charges are sent to State Courts for court application
steps.detail: No charge generator or sending of charges to State Courts in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi. Icourtcase.d.ts:11,43-47 are only types (complaint_code, b_lob_chargesheet, file_name_chargesheet) with no code filling them. The State Courts interface cannot verify from repo.
